name: Runtime CLI
description: CLI interface for managing ClaudeClockwork execution runtimes (default, adaptive, claude-min)
author: ClaudeClockwork

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action: menu (interactive), list (show all), get (show current), set (change), info (details)

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: Runtime name for set action: default, adaptive, or claude-min

examples: /runtime set default - Switch to Pure Ollama runtime
/runtime set adaptive - Switch to Adaptive runtime
/runtime set claude-min - Switch to Claude Minimal runtime
